 function print_fest_time(date, hour, minutes, seconds) {
 	const day = date.getDate();
 	const month = date.getMonth() + 1;
 	const year = date.getFullYear();

 	return `${day}/${month}/${year}`;
 } 
 // Call the function.
 print_fest_time(new Date(), now.hours, now.minutes, now.seconds);
